parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the main vessel of the coffee machine, typically made of glass to hold the brewed coffee.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid coffee after brewing and allows pouring through its handle and spout.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached from the base for cleaning and pouring but remains stationary during brewing.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a plastic cover that fits on top of the container to prevent spills and retain heat.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the container during brewing to maintain temperature and prevent splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or rotated slightly for cleaning or pouring.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: The knob is a small plastic control element located on the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to control the power and brewing settings of the coffee machine.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or clicks to adjust settings or turn the machine on/off.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is a metallic spout or outlet through which brewed coffee flows into the container.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of coffee from the brewing chamber into the container.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but allows liquid flow through its channel.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the coffee machine, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electrical components, heating element, and supports the container.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and provides structural stability.
